exceptions.reason: The file imports the entry point of Popover, which Vase UI does not have. The cases run for Popover and Menu. The block `Menu` of the Vase UI file has the cases for Menu. The cases for Popover are not ported yet.

exceptions.title: does not throw in production when the same element is registered under multiple ids
exceptions.reason: The case needs a production build. Vitest sets `process.env.NODE_ENV` when it transforms a file for a browser, so only the Node project can change it.
